name: Uber Notebook
author: marcho78
description: Your notes in the Omarchy shell. Press Super+N (or click the notebook in the top bar) and Pages opens: a workspace of pages made of blocks, the Notion way, with to-dos, toggles, tables, boards, mind maps, sketches, equations, diagrams, pictures and files, and your AI agent (Claude Code, Grok or Codex) working on a page in a panel. Or paper notebooks that move to Pages in a click. Quick notes from anywhere with Super+Alt+N, search across everything, and plain files in ~/Documents/Uber Notebook.

barWidget.description: Your notebooks. Click to open, right-click for a quick note.
